title: The Screaming Wall
text: A wall built of the damned, bodies mortared together, still alive, still screaming, hands clawing out between the stones. Their faces press at you as you pass. One of them is calling a Scion by name, over and over, in a voice they know.

options.label: The one being called answers the voice.

outcomes.text: An ancestor, who tells them a secret of the House before the wall swallows him back.
A liar, who only wanted to be heard, and will not stop now.

options.label: Pull him free of the wall.

outcomes.text: He comes out, and the wall comes after him.

options.label: Stop your ears and walk on.

outcomes.text: You hear it for a day after, and the name most of all.
